source.title: ಮಾಡಿ ಮಡಿದವರು (Maadi Madidavaru)
source.author: ಬಸವರಾಜ ಕಟ್ಟೀಮನಿ (Basavaraj Kattimani)
source.edition_note: Abridged Kannada novel; source PDF supplied by user
source.text_extraction_scope: Main narrative pages 5–78 of the supplied PDF

processing_notes: Sentence records are extracted from OCR/text extraction and retain source wording as far as extraction allows.
Paragraph records are contiguous groups of up to five extracted sentences from the same PDF page; they are not asserted to reproduce the original typographic paragraph boundaries.
Vocabulary entries are candidate dialect forms observed in dialogue, not confirmed exclusive North Karnataka vocabulary.
The narrative is set around Belagavi/Kallapur and includes region-marked dialogue; not every sentence in the novel is necessarily North Karnataka dialect.
OCR may contain errors, especially in older/scanned print. Review the source page before treating a spelling or form as verified.
All entries are initially marked unverified; do not use the whole corpus as clean dialect gold labels without manual review.
schema_note: Sentence and paragraph files include source_page, locality, dialect_evidence/text_unit, and verification_status fields in addition to core text and region labels.
